community.title: Campus Circles
community.subtitle: Anonymous, moderated peer circles. Your name, roll number and institution are never shown to peers.
community.normsClose: I agree and will respect the space
community.norm1: What is shared in the circle stays in the circle. Screenshots and quoting peers outside are not allowed.
community.norm2: We do not compare CGPA, packages or ranks. We focus on wellbeing.
community.norm3: Posts are screened by AI before they appear. Posts about harming yourself are never published. We show you helplines instead.
